dataset: AZT1D 2025 (Mendeley gk9m674wcx v1): adults with type 1 diabetes on Control-IQ, Dexcom G6
context: IOB and COB from user-entered boluses and carbs only; automatic boluses and basal respond to the CGM and are left out (D9)
labelled: Nothing is labelled as PISA. Injected PISAs are known exactly; real compression artifacts in the reference count as true lows, and Control-IQ already suspended insulin for some of them, which the reference cannot show.
